'''''Sulcasky! An Exhibition''''' was a [[Painting/Legends|poster]] used to promote [[Sulcasky!/Legends|Sulcasky!]], an exhibition on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]<ref name="Duchess" /> and [[Iego/Legends|Iego]]<ref name="Mystery of a Thousand Moons">{{TCW|Mystery of a Thousand Moons}}</ref> at the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Both billboards and regular posters were used and featured a motif of a kneeling figure and [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] text.<ref name="Duchess" />
